system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The supplied evidence consists of three Sysmon Event ID 13 registry-value changes on WS-LMARTINS-01, made by explorer.exe under NWD\leo.martins, at 13:34:11, 13:42:52, and 14:09:12 UTC.
The ROT13-encoded UserAssist value paths refer to Firefox at 13:34 and 14:09, and a Teams Start Menu shortcut at 13:42.
These records do not establish whether the reported failed domain logons occurred or whether the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records are Sysmon registry events, not authentication events; they provide no logon result, authentication protocol, source host, or source address (T031-00001, T031-00004, T031-00006).
The records do not include process-creation or network-connection telemetry that would confirm what activity accompanied these registry changes (T031-00001, T031-00004, T031-00006).
claims_not_established: Whether repeated failed domain logons for leo.martins occurred during the alert window.
Whether any failed logons were followed by a successful logon or account compromise.
The source of any alleged authentication attempts, their cause, or whether they were authorized.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain-controller authentication and account-lockout events for leo.martins from 13:20 to 14:20 UTC on 2026-10-27, including result codes and source workstation or address.
Relevant workstation logon events and process/network telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01 and any identified source host during the same period.
Correlated account activity before and after the window, including successful logons and any password or account changes.
